review_scope: Serious receipt/schema, payload-identity and scope errors only. This is a static preparation review, not a completed-chain or bundle-execution receipt.

resolved_findings.initial_problem: Checking every base64 member against its own declared SHA-256 did not establish that the AR payload actually contained the exact verified public PDF and OTS proof named by verification metadata.
resolved_findings.final_resolution: The final source rejects duplicate AR member paths, decodes and hashes every member, and requires the canonical papers/TA-TR-2026-26/PDF member to equal the verified public PDF bytes and the canonical proofs/TA-TR-2026-26/PDF.ots member to equal the locally hash-verified proof bytes. Target report, DOI, filename, length and public PDF hash are also fixed.

resolved_findings.initial_problem: A nine-row receipt and equality of filename sets alone did not exclude duplicate receipt names paired with fewer distinct public files.
resolved_findings.final_resolution: The final source requires exactly nine receipt rows and exact equality of receipt names, staged public file names and the fixed nine-name publisher set; each public file's byte length and SHA-256 must match the chain receipt.

checks.check: The chain must explicitly report DOI_OTS_ARWEAVE_PUBLIC_READBACK_COMPLETE for DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23279189, with root AR hash-match evidence

Workflow status must be ARWEAVE_READBACK_PASS; uploader result must be uploaded with hash_match=true; local bundle SHA, uploader payload/readback SHA, workflow bundle SHA and root readback SHA must agree
Transaction IDs are matched across workflow status, uploader receipt and root readback; frozen targets are identical; one PDF has BITCOIN_VERIFIED_REMOTE_HEADERS and nonempty attested heights
Verified target fields match the actual research_paper_ots.py output schema: report and DOI are added to the original target item, including name/bytes/sha256, with proof metadata added afterward
checks.schema_evidence: Read-only source comparison with ctd_v10/release_review/post_doi_main/scripts/research_paper_ots.py, plus field names in the actual pending preservation status; no completed receipt was fabricated.

checks.check: The timestamped public PDF is fixed at 269961 bytes and SHA-256 479b4f2403ad7416f99f7676533fd4a8b9efed1bb289c7fcd52f64a09bf81c94; AR member bytes and the local verified OTS proof are bound to those exact originals

The three reserved root entries FINAL_CHAIN_RECEIPT.json, PUBLICATION_COMPLETION_ZH.md and DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json cannot silently replace existing staged entries; duplicated preservation paths and file symlinks are rejected
Known unfinished-report placeholders are rejected; the delivery manifest records exact file bytes/hashes; after creation the ZIP is reopened for CRC, member-count and per-member byte checks
The delivery ZIP is explicitly distinguished from the Arweave payload; a distribution/viewer PDF variant is not substituted for the hash-bound original public PDF

operational_limits: Only actual successful chain and readback receipts authorize this builder's completed-state output. Its existence and this static review do not establish chain completion.
Bitcoin verification is the declared OTS cryptography plus agreeing remote-header model, not a new local-full-node consensus verification performed by this builder or reviewer.
Root must fill final status prose from actual operation receipts; this review does not approve invented completion language or backdating an earlier pending receipt.

The separate delivered ZIP, exact original public PDF, detached OTS proof and AR payload have distinct hashes and scopes. A viewer/library PDF with added distribution metadata is outside the original PDF byte identity.
